messages:
elena-cs: urgent - AcmeMaps just opened a support ticket: after the us-east-1 outage their requests routed to eu-west-1 and responses are wildly degraded. customer says summaries are truncated and tokens look doubled. original model pinned: gptx-4-std-16, served model: gptx-4-lite-8q.

elena-cs: repro steps from customer (copied):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXX' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-4-std-16","input":"Summarize this...","region":"useast1"}'
```

elena-cs: response they got (truncated & different):
```
{"id":"r_123","model":"gptx-4-lite-8q","output":"...incomplete summary","token_count":473}
```

elena-cs: customer noticed token_count jumped 2x compared to baseline which also spiked billing. they attached request-id 2026-03-17T11:22:04Z -> route: eu-west-1 fallback.

deploy-bot: [automated] failover event 2026-03-17T11:22:03Z: route_policy=latency_preference, source_region=useast1, target_region=eu-west-1, reason=host_oom, fallback_variant=cheapest_compatible

marco-sre: pinging eng-runtime & ml infra. can you pull the routing trace for req id 2026-03-17T11:22:04Z and confirm variant selection logic? :eyes:

marco-sre: also need logs from the proxy that applied the fallback policy (should show model mapping lookup).

tanvi-ml: looking. initial glance: mapping table has an entry that maps gptx-4-std-16 -> [gptx-4-std-16, gptx-4-std-8q, gptx-4-lite-8q]. the runtime has a bug where, under capacity pressure, it picks the last element rather than the nearest in capability. that's why lite-8q was chosen.

tanvi-ml: consequence: tokenizer config differs (byte-pair merges changed) so token_count changes and some special tokens are missing -> truncation. not just quantization quality drop, it's a tokenizer/config drift.

jason-eng: ack. that's a bad fallback ordering. we intentionally prefer minimal capability delta but an off-by-one in the selection loop can bias toward the cheapest. opening a patch now.

jason-eng: temporary mitigation: disable cross-region variant fallback for pinned model_ids and force fallback to the same model family in the same capabilities bucket. I can flip a kill-switch for 1 hour. need ops approval.

priya-se: customer-facing update draft: "We're investigating a routing failover that caused your requests to be served by a lower-capability model variant in a different region. We're pausing automatic downgrade fallbacks for your workspace while we fix this." happy to send once we have ETA.

marco-sre: ops - please approve the kill-switch. this is affecting production quality for a paying customer.

acct-billing: FYI - we see an anomalous billing delta for acct AcmeMaps: +120% tokens in the window 11:20-11:30 UTC. if this is indeed caused by tokenization differences we should consider a billing credit. filing ticket BILL-9876.

jason-eng: patch queued. quick fix: change selection from selecting the last compatible variant to selecting the first compatible variant ordered by capability closeness. will roll canary to eng-runtime in eu-west-1 first.

tanvi-ml: also adding a tokenizer-compat check during mapping resolution to avoid cross-variant tokenizers unless explicitly marked compatible.

elena-cs: customer wants repro steps so they can validate after fix. shared a small corpus and golden summaries. attaching to the support ticket.

marco-sre: summarize action items: 1) ops approve temporary fallback disable (jason), 2) eng-runtime patch deploy canary (jason), 3) tokenizer-compat guard (tanvi), 4) billing review & possible credit (acct-billing), 5) customer communication (priya).

priya-se: I'll send the customer note now and include rollback timeframe and a point of contact. :white_check_mark:

acct-billing: billing ticket created BILL-9876, assigned to @liz-billing. tagging finance for review.

jason-eng: can someone upload the full proxy trace (headers + model_selection log) for that request id? need the exact selection decision payload.

elena-cs: uploaded trace link: https://internal.redwood/sup/trace/2026-03-17-112204 (internal)

marco-sre: confirming kill-switch approved by ops on call. jason, you have a green light to push temporary disable across regions.

jason-eng: pushing canary to eu-west-1 now, will monitor error/latency metrics and tokenization diffs. ETA 10m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] eng-runtime v2.14.3-canary deployed to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T11:31:12Z by jason-eng

elena-cs: customer verified after canary: responses now served by gptx-4-std-16 in eu-west-1 and look correct. they reported summaries match golden set for 5/5 samples.

priya-se: sent updated note to customer with timeline and next steps. customer is satisfied with temporary fix but asked for a permanent root cause write-up.

tanvi-ml: will follow up with an RFC to lock model mapping semantics + tokenizer-compat checks.

acct-billing: billing team will draft a credit proposal, marking it P1.

elena-cs: marking this thread resolved for support; keeping eng owners assigned until RFC merged. thanks all :heart:
